exposure: Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation (WIMD) score
Maternal BMI at booking (healthy vs. unhealthy)
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing elective caesarean section in South Wales (Grown in Wales cohort)
finding: A Health Conscious dietary pattern during pregnancy was associated with increased hPL levels, specifically in women with a healthy BMI, and higher hPL levels were associated with increased CBWC and a higher likelihood of large for gestational age deliveries.
